हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: Armaan marries Kavya, the woman accused of killing his brother, to expose her as a serial husband killer. But as their dangerous game unfolds, he discovers Kavya is being forced into these crimes by her abusive stepfamily, who hold her mother hostage. Torn between revenge and love, Armaan must protect the very woman he set out to destroy, before their enemies strike again.
